articles.title: Budget: What is expected on debt, military, infrastructure?
articles.summary: India is set to announce its annual budget, with the Defence Ministry actively seeking increased military spending to bolster national security. Concurrently, industry stakeholders are urging reductions in tax rates on market transactions and customs duties to stimulate economic growth. This pivotal budget will outline key fiscal policies impacting defence capabilities and the broader economy, a critical update for SSB aspirants.

articles.title: Race against nature: BRO clears 5 feet of snow in 72 hours to reopen vital Kishtwar-Sansari lifeline at 8,700 feet
articles.summary: The Border Roads Organisation (BRO) achieved a significant feat by restoring the 112-km Kishtwar-Sansari road in a record seven days. This crucial road links Jammu & Kashmir's Kishtwar district with Himachal Pradesh's Lahaul Spiti. This rapid infrastructure development highlights BRO's efficiency in maintaining vital connectivity in challenging border regions, which is essential for national security, strategic movements, and regional socio-economic development.

articles.title: Budget 2026: HAL, BEL And Other Defence Stocks In Focus As Investors Eye 8-10% Outlay Rise
articles.summary: Defence-linked stocks will be closely watched during the Union Budget 2026, with expectations of a moderate increase in defence spending. For SSB aspirants, this highlights the government's continued emphasis on indigenisation, aiming to bolster India's domestic defence manufacturing and reduce import reliance. This focus is crucial for enhancing national security and achieving strategic autonomy.
